tweets.text: ICE Acting Director Albence: "One other common myth I’d like to discuss is that ICE performs random enforcement sweeps or raids. Nothing could be further from the truth." (18/)
tweets.text_resolved: ICE Acting Director Albence: "One other common myth I’d like to discuss is that ICE performs random enforcement sweeps or raids. Nothing could be further from the truth." (18/)

tweets.text: "70% of the people that ICE arrests for immigration violations come to us directly from the custody of another law enforcement agency, as thankfully, the vast majority of law enforcement agencies in this country cooperate with us." (19/)
tweets.text_resolved: "70% of the people that ICE arrests for immigration violations come to us directly from the custody of another law enforcement agency, as thankfully, the vast majority of law enforcement agencies in this country cooperate with us." (19/)

tweets.text: "Nearly 9 out of 10 people we arrest are convicted criminals, have been charged with a criminal offense, are a fugitive, or were deported previously and again illegally re-entered—a federal felony that we prosecute about 7,000 times per year." (20/)
tweets.text_resolved: "Nearly 9 out of 10 people we arrest are convicted criminals, have been charged with a criminal offense, are a fugitive, or were deported previously and again illegally re-entered—a federal felony that we prosecute about 7,000 times per year." (20/)

tweets.text: ICE Acting Director Albence: "One final point that I will address is the process—what happens to an alien when ICE arrests them.  Unlike some would have you believe, they are not whisked off in the middle of the night never to be heard from again." (23/)
tweets.text_resolved: ICE Acting Director Albence: "One final point that I will address is the process—what happens to an alien when ICE arrests them.  Unlike some would have you believe, they are not whisked off in the middle of the night never to be heard from again." (23/)

tweets.text: "Unless they are a fugitive, meaning they have already been afforded due process and have ignored a lawfully issued removal order, an arrest by ICE is just the start of the process." (24/)
tweets.text_resolved: "Unless they are a fugitive, meaning they have already been afforded due process and have ignored a lawfully issued removal order, an arrest by ICE is just the start of the process." (24/)

tweets.text: "Just like if the individual were arrested by NYPD or any other law enforcement agency for a criminal violation, there is a defined process in which the individual will have the right to a hearing before an Immigration Judge with the Department of Justice." (25/)
tweets.text_resolved: "Just like if the individual were arrested by NYPD or any other law enforcement agency for a criminal violation, there is a defined process in which the individual will have the right to a hearing before an Immigration Judge with the Department of Justice." (25/)

tweets.text: "They have the right to present evidence on their behalf. They can be represented by counsel. They have the ability to apply for asylum or other forms of relief from removal." (26/)
tweets.text_resolved: "They have the right to present evidence on their behalf. They can be represented by counsel. They have the ability to apply for asylum or other forms of relief from removal." (26/)

tweets.text: "And if they don’t like the ruling of the Immigration Judge, they can appeal to the Board of Immigration Appeals, U.S. Circuit Courts, and ultimately, the Supreme Court." (27/)
tweets.text_resolved: "And if they don’t like the ruling of the Immigration Judge, they can appeal to the Board of Immigration Appeals, U.S. Circuit Courts, and ultimately, the Supreme Court." (27/)

tweets.text: "But, at the end of the process, if the Immigration Judge orders them removed, and that removal order is upheld through whatever appellate process the individual has availed themselves of, it is ICE’s sworn duty to execute that removal order." (28/)
tweets.text_resolved: "But, at the end of the process, if the Immigration Judge orders them removed, and that removal order is upheld through whatever appellate process the individual has availed themselves of, it is ICE’s sworn duty to execute that removal order." (28/)

tweets.text: "ICE must enforce the laws and rulings from an Immigration Judge just like any other law enforcement agency must enforce the laws of their respective jurisdictions and judges." (29/)
tweets.text_resolved: "ICE must enforce the laws and rulings from an Immigration Judge just like any other law enforcement agency must enforce the laws of their respective jurisdictions and judges." (29/)

tweets.text: Acting Dir Albence: "In the end, here are the critical facts about these policies—they only impact aliens who commit crimes in your communities, and they prevent criminal aliens from committing additional crimes against your family, friends, and neighbors." (30/30)
tweets.text_resolved: Acting Dir Albence: "In the end, here are the critical facts about these policies—they only impact aliens who commit crimes in your communities, and they prevent criminal aliens from committing additional crimes against your family, friends, and neighbors." (30/30)

tweets.text: ICE Acting Director Albence: "So, today I plead with the people of New York City and all other sanctuary cities throughout this country...  Let ICE help keep your communities safer.  Allow ICE to prevent crimes such as this sexual assault and murder." (1/)
tweets.text_resolved: ICE Acting Director Albence: "So, today I plead with the people of New York City and all other sanctuary cities throughout this country...  Let ICE help keep your communities safer.  Allow ICE to prevent crimes such as this sexual assault and murder." (1/)

tweets.text: "This city’s policies—and those like them elsewhere in the country—make all of us less safe; that is the opposite of what the primary goal of every law enforcement agency, and every elected official should be." (2/)
tweets.text_resolved: "This city’s policies—and those like them elsewhere in the country—make all of us less safe; that is the opposite of what the primary goal of every law enforcement agency, and every elected official should be." (2/)

tweets.text: "Strong local partnerships  are vital to successful law enforcement, & as a career law-enforcement professional." (3/)
tweets.text_resolved: "Strong local partnerships  are vital to successful law enforcement, & as a career law-enforcement professional." (3/)

tweets.text: ICE Acting Director Albence: "I’d like to explain ICE detainers. ICE issues detainers to advise our local law enforcement partners that we have established probable cause to believe an individual, who has already been arrested..." (4/)
tweets.text_resolved: ICE Acting Director Albence: "I’d like to explain ICE detainers. ICE issues detainers to advise our local law enforcement partners that we have established probable cause to believe an individual, who has already been arrested..." (4/)

tweets.text: "... by another law enforcement agency for a criminal offense and is in their custody, is an alien who is subject to removal from the United States under federal law." (5/)
tweets.text_resolved: "... by another law enforcement agency for a criminal offense and is in their custody, is an alien who is subject to removal from the United States under federal law." (5/)

tweets.text: ICE Acting Director Albence: "ICE issues detainers and make arrests based on probable cause.  The exact same standard that the #NYPD—and every other law enforcement agency must adhere to—when they make arrests for the crimes they’re sworn to enforce." (6/)
tweets.text_resolved: ICE Acting Director Albence: "ICE issues detainers and make arrests based on probable cause.  The exact same standard that the #NYPD—and every other law enforcement agency must adhere to—when they make arrests for the crimes they’re sworn to enforce." (6/)

tweets.text: AD Albence: "When we issue a detainer, we are asking to be notified prior to the alien’s release, and for our law enforcement partners to hold that individual for a brief period so ICE may assume custody and prevent the release of criminals into the local communities." (7/)
tweets.text_resolved: AD Albence: "When we issue a detainer, we are asking to be notified prior to the alien’s release, and for our law enforcement partners to hold that individual for a brief period so ICE may assume custody and prevent the release of criminals into the local communities." (7/)

tweets.text: "There are those who will attempt to deflect criticism for these policies by stating that they would honor the ICE detainer if it is accompanied by a judicial warrant.  Those who make this claim are either willfully ignorant of the law or are patently disingenuous." (8/)
tweets.text_resolved: "There are those who will attempt to deflect criticism for these policies by stating that they would honor the ICE detainer if it is accompanied by a judicial warrant.  Those who make this claim are either willfully ignorant of the law or are patently disingenuous." (8/)

tweets.text: "ICE does not need a judicial warrant to issue a detainer, or to make an arrest." (9/)
tweets.text_resolved: "ICE does not need a judicial warrant to issue a detainer, or to make an arrest." (9/)

tweets.text: "To be perfectly clear, not only does ICE not need a judicial warrant, there is no judge or magistrate anywhere in this country who has the authority to issue a judicial warrant for a civil immigration violation." (10/)
tweets.text_resolved: "To be perfectly clear, not only does ICE not need a judicial warrant, there is no judge or magistrate anywhere in this country who has the authority to issue a judicial warrant for a civil immigration violation." (10/)

tweets.text: ICE Acting Director Albence: "Let’s also be clear about those whom ICE lodges detainers and issues warrants. These individuals are those who have already been arrested for a criminal violation and booked into jail." (11/)
tweets.text_resolved: ICE Acting Director Albence: "Let’s also be clear about those whom ICE lodges detainers and issues warrants. These individuals are those who have already been arrested for a criminal violation and booked into jail." (11/)

tweets.text: "Unfortunately, this incongruent application of laws often results in senseless, tragic victimization such as with this case.  These are preventable crimes, and more importantly, preventable victims." (12/)
tweets.text_resolved: "Unfortunately, this incongruent application of laws often results in senseless, tragic victimization such as with this case.  These are preventable crimes, and more importantly, preventable victims." (12/)

tweets.text: "In fact, most times we don’t even know that a criminal alien has been released because these sanctuary jurisdictions don’t tell us. You know how we find out our detainer wasn’t honored? The next time the individual is arrested and we get the fingerprint hit from the FBI" (13/)
tweets.text_resolved: "In fact, most times we don’t even know that a criminal alien has been released because these sanctuary jurisdictions don’t tell us. You know how we find out our detainer wasn’t honored? The next time the individual is arrested and we get the fingerprint hit from the FBI" (13/)

tweets.text: ICE Acting Director Albence: "For those who think that sanctuary policies will keep ICE out of their communities, nothing could be further from the truth." (14/)
tweets.text_resolved: ICE Acting Director Albence: "For those who think that sanctuary policies will keep ICE out of their communities, nothing could be further from the truth." (14/)

tweets.text: "ICE is mandated by Congress to enforce the immigration laws of this country, and we will continue to do so regardless of the opposition from those who hold no allegiance to the rule of law." (15/)
tweets.text_resolved: "ICE is mandated by Congress to enforce the immigration laws of this country, and we will continue to do so regardless of the opposition from those who hold no allegiance to the rule of law." (15/)

tweets.text: "Sanctuary policies leave ICE with no reasonable alternative but to increase enforcement activities in neighborhoods and workplaces to locate and arrest these persons while they are at-large." (16/)
tweets.text_resolved: "Sanctuary policies leave ICE with no reasonable alternative but to increase enforcement activities in neighborhoods and workplaces to locate and arrest these persons while they are at-large." (16/)

tweets.text: "This strains law enforcement resources, places officers and the community at risk, and results in fewer criminals ultimately being removed from our streets." (17/)
